reference.question: \(PA\) is tangent to circle \(O\) at point \(A\), and \(\angle AOP=65^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle P\) (unit: degrees).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Complementary acute angles

\(\angle OAP=90^\circ\), so \(\angle P=90^\circ-65^\circ=25^\circ\).
